note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown (imago unknown), hence only the soldier and worker sections; measurements are given in mm as recorded; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier antennae 14-segmented; mandibles vestigial, each bearing a slender, dark brown, spine-like process; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, its anterior margin without a notch; head without a nasus. Worker dimorphic: major worker body length 4.00–4.50 mm, minor worker 3.0–3.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light reddish brown to dark brown, the nasus darker than the head capsule; antennae brown to dark brown; tibiae and tarsi light brown; abdominal tergites dark smoky brown, sternites light brown. Vertex bare or with a pair of setae; a few short setae behind the base of the nasus; nasus apex with 2 pairs of short setae; pronotum with a few short setae; abdominal tergites with minute setae, sternites with long and short setae. Body length 4.0–5.2 mm. Head capsule (excluding nasus) pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae: head length including nasus 1.58–1.95 mm, head length excluding nasus 1.09–1.35 mm, maximum width 0.98–1.30 mm, width at constriction 0.70–0.75 mm, ratio of width at constriction to maximum width 0.63–0.70; posterior part of the head strongly projecting backwards, cephalic bubble length 0.40–0.55 mm, bubble index (bubble length / head length) 0.33–0.46; in lateral view distinctly incurved behind the nasus, occiput raised; nasus process absent. Compound eye a white, semi-elliptical, ill-defined spot situated behind the antenna. Nasus cylindrical, upturned apically in lateral view, about half as long as the head length excluding the nasus (length 0.55–0.60 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length excluding nasus 0.50–0.54). Antennae very long, 14-segmented; segment 3 about 2.5 times segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, each with a slender, dark brown, spine-like process. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.30–0.48 mm, maximum width 0.60–0.70 mm), anterior margin without a notch. Hind femur slightly surpassing the abdomen, length 1.70–1.80 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule brown with a reddish tinge; antennae and pronotum paler than the head capsule; femora brown with a smoky tinge; abdominal tergites chestnut brown; tibiae, tarsi and abdominal sternites straw yellow. Head and body sparsely covered with minute setae dorsally, densely hairy ventrally. Body length 4.00–4.50 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 1.10–1.15 mm, maximum width 1.30 mm); Y-suture distinct; fontanelle plate white, semi-transparent, elongate. Antennae slender, 15-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2 or 4. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, less than half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.50 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, about as long as half its width (length 0.48–0.50 mm, width 0.70 mm). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, antennae also smaller, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2 or 4. Body length 3.0–3.20 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.75–0.90 mm, maximum head width 1.00–1.13 mm, pronotum length 0.30–0.35 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm.
